FACT TO ADD/CORRECT under 'SDK Query Filters Reference': The SDK string filter escapes double quotes only. A value that ends in a backslash breaks the quoted filter value, so filters on such values (for example a path such as C:\) return a wrong or failed query. Avoid trailing backslashes in <Entity> filter values, or pass the value through a field that does not need quoting. | EVIDENCE: judo-sdk-common@8596a8e:src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/StringFilter.java:76 | judo-ng finding: getValueAsString escapes only double quotes.
